seo.title: Terms of Use | The Talisman, Karen, Nairobi
seo.description: The terms that apply when you use The Talisman website and send us a table request.

legal.body:
These terms apply when you use the website of The Talisman, 320 Ngong Road, Karen, Nairobi (“we”, “us”). By using the site you agree to them.

## Table requests

The form on our home page sends us a request, not a confirmed booking. Your table is confirmed only when a member of our team calls you back. We are open Tuesday to Sunday and closed on Mondays, so we cannot take requests for Mondays.

## Menus, prices and events

Our menus change with the seasons and with what our farm and suppliers bring in. Dishes, drinks, prices, opening hours and events shown on this site may change without notice. Please ask your server for the current menu and prices.

## Allergies and dietary needs

Our kitchen handles nuts, gluten, dairy, shellfish and other allergens. Please tell us about any allergy when you book and again when you order. We will do our best to help, but we cannot guarantee that any dish is completely free of allergens.

## Alcohol

We serve alcohol only to guests aged 18 and over, and we may ask for identification.

## Our content

The text, photographs, logo and design of this website belong to The Talisman or to the artists and photographers who allow us to use their work. Please don’t copy or reuse them without our written permission. Artwork shown on our walls remains the property of the artists.

## Using the site

Please don’t misuse the site: no attempts to break, overload or gain unauthorised access to it, and no false or abusive table requests.

## Links to other sites

Our site links to other services, such as maps, Instagram and Facebook. We are not responsible for their content or how they handle your data.

## Liability

We work to keep this site accurate and available, but we provide it “as is” and cannot promise it will always be error-free or online. As far as the law allows, we are not liable for any loss that comes from using it.

## Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of Kenya, and the courts of Kenya have jurisdiction over any dispute.

## Contact

Questions about these terms? Email [hello@talisman.co.ke](mailto:hello@talisman.co.ke) or call [+254 705 999 997](tel:+254705999997). You can also read our [Privacy Policy](privacy.html).
